Dieter Rams.description: Dieter Rams (born 1932) is a German industrial designer who served as head of design at Braun for over 30 years. His ten principles of good design — including the famous idea that 'good design is as little design as possible' — have profoundly influenced generations of product designers, including Jony Ive at Apple.

Bruno Ninaber van Eyden.description: Bruno Ninaber van Eyden (born 1950) is a Dutch product and graphic designer. He studied at the Academy of Art and Design in Den Bosch and became known for combining formal rigour with humanist sensitivity in industrial and typographic design.
